'''highgturn CCT/MFD with Jabba's Prize....Need Help PLZ''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[highgturn]]
* '''Published:''' 26 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / Cloud City Occupation|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed CCT highgturn DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is probably my first really good DS Deck I worked on it for a long time. I would like all the help I can get. All your comments are appreciated. Thanks Again.

The published list has 67 cards.

== Strategy ==

1st turn: Use CCT to get Audience Chamber (for the two force you generate). Drop a warrior or bounty hunter to Security Tower and grab Jabba's Prize. Use CCC to pull an Ugnaught. Try to find out where your Den of Thieves is. If it's not in your Reserve Deck draw cards until you get it. Move your escort with the Prize to CC: Carbonite Chamber.

2nd turn: Pull Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 or CC: East Landing Platform with CCT. Drop some guys down with your escort to protect him. Move them all the the Platform if possible. Pull an Ugunaut with CCC, use the Ugunaughts to stop the early Force Drains.

3rd turn: Get the last docking bay. Grab a 3rd Ugunaught. Move one space closer to the Audience Chamber.

Keep moving, you should be able to flip in no more than 6 turns. You can use JP: AC text to pull Jade if need be. I prefer to wait until I get Blizzard 4, the deploy her for free aboard. Alternatly you can pull Jabba (after you flip) and deploy him there. Wait to deploy Scum and Villiany until you flip for obvious reasons. After you flip I recommend EITHER spreading out and draining (CC: PTD is a good place to drain after you flip Aliens deploy -2 and FD is +1). Or battle like crazy (you retrive 3 force each time you battle). I would also consider dropping Ugnaughts like crazy so you can retrive with Abyssian Ornament.

The Destroyers are obviously in case the opponent goes into space. DUH!

Please lemme know what you think of this deck and strategy. Later. God Bless
